announcement.title: Guidance
announcement.intro: The Prince of Songkla University graduate employment database system was developed to track and evaluate the employment status of graduates after graduation.
announcement.card_title: This questionnaire has 2 parts (All parts must be answered)
announcement.item_1: When recording data, please answer completely. If there is no information in any matter, put <1>-</1> <2>(Do not leave blank as the system will not be able to save and proceed to the next page)</2>
announcement.item_2:
After data entry is complete, if you cannot print the certificate strictly immediately, graduates can come back to Print
the certificate later. Go to the topic <1>"Print Report" <2>without recording new data!!!
